definitions.explanation: Clothing designed to protect the body from cold weather. Includes heavy jackets, insulated pants, thermal layers, and similar garments.

examples.japanese: {防寒服|ぼうかんふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I put on cold-weather clothing and headed out.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防寒|ぼうかん}→防寒：17388_boukan⟧ (protection from cold) + ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (clothing). A practical compound used in contexts ranging from everyday winter wear to specialized outdoor and industrial gear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防寒服|ぼうかんふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear cold-weather clothing
- {防寒服|ぼうかんふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧: to prepare cold-weather clothing
- ⟦{厚手|あつで}→厚手：28592_atsude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防寒服|ぼうかんふく}: thick cold-weather clothing
- {軍用|ぐんよう}{防寒服|ぼうかんふく}: military cold-weather gear
